value.title: Builder team lifecycle — proof and backpressure survey

value.criterion: ac-0001: The packaged CLI exposes the Builder lifecycle through discoverable help and instructions with the existing JSON envelope/exit conventions; missing prerequisites, name collisions and unsupported runtime capabilities are explicit rather than silent success.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: implement and pave the guide-owned real CLI/consumer/example proof for surface; then run npm run smoke:builder. This command is proposed, not runnable acceptance proof yet.
value.note: Planned acceptance proof; the product contract is not implemented or proven yet. Structural tests do not replace independent architectural judgement or the actual pinned OMP dogfood. Existing baseline fast-suite evidence is not new-feature or full-suite evidence.

value.criterion: ac-0002: New workspace creation atomically reserves the next ordinal against the shared repository and sibling worktrees, records a resumable allocation before Git mutation, never reuses closed reservations, and refuses conflicting or escaping paths without clobbering existing work.

value.proof: Independent OMP Opus 5 high judgement against the committed composition and frozen plan/guide, plus PM-verified complete manual Builder/harness lifecycle evidence. Automated behavior and schema checks prove their own scopes, not this judgement or an unobserved run.
value.note: Inspected the root manifest/recipes, harness/cli Vitest/architecture/contract suites and live CLI/OMP canary paths. Those instruments expose runtime/behavior facts; none substitutes for independent architectural judgement and an observed end-to-end manual lifecycle. No provider-served model attestation is claimed.

value.criterion: ac-0012: Builder, eng-harness-flow and their templates use the local ddocs CLI and one canonical assets/backpressure.dd.json source to record the actual selected proof approach, link every AC and task assertion to its pressure row, and link observed proof receipts back to the AC; the documented recipe is executed and validated, not merely checked for wording.

value.note: The source-backed compatibility audit is assets/flow-eval-audit.md. Native explicit-identity ingest has a verified route; the evaluator adapter and final live run are not yet implemented/proven. Unknown telemetry and served-model attestation remain explicit.
